SELECT * FROM ( SELECT wr.week_key, u.id AS user_id, t.name AS team_name, u.name AS member_name, ri.id AS item_id, ri.content, NULL AS parent_content, 'main' AS type, ri.status, ri.due_date, ri.cycle FROM report_items ri JOIN weekly_reports wr ON wr.id = ri.weekly_report_id JOIN users u ON u.id = wr.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = CASE WHEN ri.source_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN ri.source_team_id ELSE u.team_id END WHERE (#{weekKey} IS NULL OR wr.week_key = #{weekKey}) AND (#{teamId} IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN ri.source_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN ri.source_team_id ELSE u.team_id END) = #{teamId}) AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR u.id = #{userId}) AND (#{query} IS NULL OR #{query} = '' OR LOWER(ri.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(u.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%')) UNION ALL SELECT wr.week_key, u.id AS user_id, t.name AS team_name, u.name AS member_name, ri.id AS item_id, rid.text AS content, ri.content AS parent_content, 'sub' AS type, ri.status, rid.due_date, rid.cycle FROM report_item_details rid JOIN report_items ri ON ri.id = rid.report_item_id JOIN weekly_reports wr ON wr.id = ri.weekly_report_id JOIN users u ON u.id = wr.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = CASE WHEN ri.source_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN ri.source_team_id ELSE u.team_id END WHERE (#{weekKey} IS NULL OR wr.week_key = #{weekKey}) AND (#{teamId} IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN ri.source_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN ri.source_team_id ELSE u.team_id END) = #{teamId}) AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR u.id = #{userId}) AND (#{query} IS NOT NULL AND #{query} <> '' AND LOWER(rid.text) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%')) ) s ORDER BY s.week_key DESC, s.member_name, s.type
